name: 7qgnnc-checkpoint-due
goal: Keep verified started watchdog work eligible for continuation while holding first unattended starts until due

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Live Tracker 3cc7319d54 watched 2svw96 #1272 close after its context checkpoint at 14:22:49Z, then recovery was held as item is not due at 14:23:53Z despite its prior started receipt.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The focused due gate tested future work without a recorded start. The existing native tmux recovery case already seeds future deadlines, but its earlier pause assertion needed the open-item hold behavior from #485 before it could reach recovery.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Formal red c3d663cae42d on the existing dispatcher cases: the recovery request returned item is not due and the answered live attempt was ignored. The unchanged MB2 native tmux case also exhausted its recovery budget before the future deadline.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Require an observed start from a local run receipt at recovery request, queue, claim and host startup. A matching started run can resume in its existing live session. Keep fresh or unstarted work behind the due gate and retain all other holds.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Exact unchanged dispatcher proof passed at e38d75611b after formal red c3d663cae4 in one identical environment. Harbor-mbp-2 native tmux ran the same test on both commits. It reached one fresh same-model and effort pane with the original checkpoint on green.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
